clip_script: This is the Golden Rule of VAT. The shop's price—the Price Excluding VAT—is the base. It is the starting point. It is 100%. The VAT is 15% of that base. So, what happens when you add them together? The final Price Including VAT is the 100% (the shop's money) PLUS the 15% (the government's money). That means the Price Including VAT is equal to 115% of the original price. A big mistake students make is they take the final price and try to just minus 15% off it. No, no, no! That 15% VAT is calculated on the smaller starting price, not the bigger final price. If you just subtract 15% from the final price, you are taking a piece of a bigger pie. It won't work out. We need to work backwards from 115% to get back to 100%.
visual_style: Fast-paced whiteboard animation. Highlight '100% + 15% = 115%' in bright colors. Red 'X' over a 'Final Price - 15%' calculation.
